t: A board game where young children program turtles with code cards.
steps: Find the Robot Turtles game from ThinkFun. The thinkfun.com site now redirects to a Ravensburger page.
Check the current price at a retailer and buy a set.
Have one adult read the rulebook.
Set up the board, turtle tiles and obstacle tiles.
Start with the first level, where children move turtles to the gem.
Add walls and crates once children are comfortable.
Bring in written programs and the Function Frog card last.
